ledger_summary.notes: Episode 10 is the first analyzed episode in this ledger run; all placeholder IDs are first-use.

executive_summary: Episode 10 presents host commentary on the Charlie Kirk assassination investigation and surrounding narratives. Primary artifacts include clips of Erika Kirk's widow remarks, Benjamin Netanyahu's Fox News interview, Charlie Kirk's Megan Kelly interview, Greta Van Susteren's interview with Netanyahu, Michael Savage commentary, and surveillance/press materials from TMZ, Governor Cox, and Discord. Claims focus on alleged misrepresentations of a May 2 letter, a Hamptons intervention by Bill Ackman, a Netanyahu phone invitation, and investigative timeline inconsistencies (outfit changes, weapon handling, confession timing). Epistemic flags raised: transcript names 'Aman' likely Bill Ackman, 'Galain' likely Ghislaine Maxwell, 'MSAD' likely Mossad.

optional_flags.description: Transcript spells 'Aman'; likely Bill Ackman (billionaire, contextual references to tens of millions in funding, Tucker Carlson dispute).
Transcript spells 'Galain'; canonical Ghislaine Maxwell (Epstein associate, daughter of Robert Maxwell).
Transcript spells 'Sigman Freud' twice and 'Sigman Freud' once; canonical Sigmund Freud.
Transcript spells 'Schlommo Sand'; canonical Shlomo Sand (Tel Aviv University historian, 'The Invention of the Jewish People').
Transcript 'Abraham Pollock'; canonical name uncertain. Could refer to Arthur Koestler 'The Thirteenth Tribe' or Arthur Polokoff (not a known figure). Requires human verification.
CLAIM_14 (Kirk shot at 12:23 PM) is universally established but not anchored to a specific shown artifact in this episode; included as core fact but flagged for weak anchoring.
Host says 'that money is now going to the father of this child' referencing Bill Ackman offer; unclear whether she means a standing reward or speculation.
